title: Right lifting against a marked coanodyne closure is tested on generators
statement: Use marked simplicial sets and the marked coanodyne class of [def-coef-infinity-marked-coanodyne]. Let $J$ be the four generating families listed there (inner horns, marked initial horns, the marked 2-simplex generator, and $K^\flat\to K^\sharp$ for Kan complexes), and let $\langle J\rangle$ be their closure under isomorphisms, pushouts, small transfinite compositions and retracts. For every marked map $q:X\to Y$, $q$ has the right lifting property against every map in $\langle J\rangle$ if and only if it has the right lifting property against every member of $J$.
